recommendation.reason: New S2Bench is real, diverse, and solid; its programmatic checker and 128 expert-referenced scenes make it recommendable.
risks: Six proprietary bridge scans are withheld, so task data is only partial.
Rhino 8 CAD/BIM kernel must be packaged into Harbor containers.
No public repository for harness, checker, or trajectories is linked.
